systems.summary: Decoupled retail banking microservices (`manager`, `deposit`, `loan`) communicating over Google ADK Agent-to-Agent (A2A) JSON-RPC + MCP Database Toolbox, paired with a stateful LangGraph intent router and deterministic underwriting math.
systems.tradeoff: Isolated loan debt-to-equity arithmetic inside a deterministic Python `BaseAgent` (`TotalValueAgent`) and exposed only a boolean `check-minimum-balance` A2A endpoint on `DepositAgent`—eliminating LLM math hallucinations and cross-service balance disclosure.
highlights: Decoupled A2A Microservices (`manager/`, `deposit/`, `loan/`): Domain agents expose standard `/.well-known/agent-card.json` descriptors and communicate strictly via A2A JSON-RPC with zero shared-memory coupling.

Deterministic Underwriting Math (`TotalValueAgent`): Debt summation and minimum required deposit equity thresholds execute inside a deterministic Python `BaseAgent`—eliminating LLM arithmetic hallucinations.

Zero-Knowledge Deposit Equity Verification: During loan underwriting, `LoanAgent` queries `DepositAgent` via A2A (`check-minimum-balance`) receiving only a strict boolean (`meets_minimum: true/false`) without ever exposing raw customer deposit balances across domains, hardened against substring parsing bugs (`test_equity.py`).

LangGraph Multi-Turn Intent Engine (`workflow.py`): Classifies customer requests into bounded Pydantic `UserIntent` schemas (`qa`, `summarization`, `calculation`), dynamically selects domain system prompts, executes an AST-validated `@tool calculator` with audit logging (`logs/tools.log`), and persists multi-turn sessions via `MemorySaver`.
